caption: A motorcycle idles at a kerb, and its rear-view mirror blurs and the reflection in it shakes until the engine is switched off.

sa.check: A motorcycle stands at a kerb with a rear-view mirror in view.
The mirror blurs and the reflection in it shakes.
The engine is switched off: a key or switch is worked, or the shaking stops.
The bike stays at the kerb.
The mirror shakes first, the engine is switched off, and the shaking stops.

pc.expect: The mirror shakes only while the engine runs and is sharp after the engine is cut.
pc.fail: The mirror shakes after the engine has been switched off and the bike stands still; or the mirror is blurred while the rest of the bike shows no tremble at all; or the blur comes and goes while nothing changes at the engine.

pc.expect: The housing's tremble carries into the reflection: the image jitters with the housing and steadies once the engine cuts.
pc.fail: The mirror housing trembles while the reflection inside stays rock steady; or the reflection jitters while the housing is sharp and still; or the switch is worked and the blur continues unchanged to the end.

pc.expect: The bike rests on its stand or wheels.
pc.fail: The bike lifts; or leans past its stand and hangs; or rises.

pc.expect: The mirror and its stalk are rigid; the blur is motion, not a change of shape.
pc.fail: The mirror stalk bends like rubber; or the mirror glass bulges; or the housing stretches.

pc.expect: One bike; the mirrors keep their count and stay attached.
pc.fail: A second mirror appears; or the mirror vanishes; or the mirror detaches and hangs in the air; or the bike changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bike's colour, the kerb and the mirror's shape stay the same.
pc.fail: The bike changes colour; or the kerb changes; or the mirror changes shape.

note: What the reflection shows is not judged; only whether it jitters together with the housing. The rider is a trigger.
